story:
An angel tells Zechariah that he and Elizabeth will have a son named John, who will get people ready for Jesus (Luke 1:5-25, 57-66). Grandpa Sol tells the story to Zara, Eli and Pip, with a sing-along song at the end.

Memory line: God keeps His promises in His perfect time!

Talk about it together:
Ages 2-3: What was the baby's name? (John!)
Ages 4-8: Why were Zechariah and Elizabeth sad? What did the angel promise? What did John grow up to do?
Prayer: Dear God, help us trust You while we wait. Thank You for keeping Your promises. Amen.
Activity (5 minutes): Light a candle (with a grown-up) and talk about something you are waiting for. Pray and thank God that He is never late.

🎵 Sing along with the lyrics:

[Verse 1]
Zechariah and Elizabeth
Loved the Lord with all their heart
They had waited many years
For a baby, with happy tears

[Chorus]
God's perfect time, God's perfect time
He keeps His promise every time
Wait and trust and sing with me
God's perfect time is the best to be!

[Verse 2]
An angel came, "Do not fear!
Good news, good news, God hears!
A baby boy, his name is John
He will get the people ready for the Son"

[Chorus]
God's perfect time, God's perfect time
He keeps His promise every time
Wait and trust and sing with me
God's perfect time is the best to be!

[Verse 3]
Baby John was born one day
Zechariah wrote his name
Then his voice came back to praise
Thank You, God, for all Your ways

[Chorus - lifted]
God's perfect time, God's perfect time
He keeps His promise every time
Wait and trust and sing with me
God's perfect time is the best to be!

[Outro]
God's perfect time!
Thank You, God!

#BibleStoriesForKids #Advent #Eliora
